title: column operation
description: Multistage distillation column — the SAME unit as `distillationColumn` under its shorter name; both read the identical operation block. Multistage distillation column with constant molar overflow. Solved by the sequential bubble-point method (Wang-Henke, default) or the rigorous simultaneous MESH Newton, which is stable on azeotropes.

nStages.title: Internal stages
nStages.description: Equilibrium stages between condenser and reboiler. Total stages = nStages + 2.

feedStage.title: Feed stage
feedStage.description: 1-indexed stage where the single feed enters (1 = top tray below the condenser). Omit it when the column declares a `feeds` list, which is required once there is more than one input stream.

refluxRatio.title: Reflux ratio
refluxRatio.description: L/D, liquid returned to the column over distillate withdrawn.

P.title: Operating pressure
P.description: Column pressure, constant across all stages. Falls back to the feed-stream pressure if omitted.

feedQuality.title: Feed quality q
feedQuality.description: Feed thermal condition: q = 1 saturated liquid, q = 0 saturated vapour.

method.title: Solution method
method.description: WangHenke (sequential bubble-point, the default, fine for ideal systems) or simultaneous (rigorous MESH Newton, stable through an azeotrope where the bubble-point route is not). Also settable in the unit's `model` slot.

feeds.title: Multiple feeds
feeds.description: Maps each input stream to a stage — REQUIRED once the column has more than one input, since positional binding cannot say which stream enters where. Replaces the single `feedStage`.

quality.title: Feed quality q of this feed

sideDraws.title: Side draws
sideDraws.description: Product withdrawn between the ends. A draw's phase decides which internal traffic it removes, so it is a separation decision, not just a flow.

murphreeEfficiency.title: Murphree tray efficiency
murphreeEfficiency.description: Fraction of the equilibrium change each tray actually achieves; defaults to 1 (equilibrium stages). Below 1 the run announces that the stages are no longer theoretical.

hydraulics.title: Tray hydraulics (rating pass)
hydraulics.description: Present = run a hydraulic RATING on the converged profile, which the stage equations never do: can the trays pass the traffic? Give `diameter` to rate an existing tower (how close to flood is each tray?); omit it to have the diameter SIZED to the `floodFraction` target. Reports entrainment flooding, downcomer flooding and weeping — a column that floods separates nothing, and the MESH solution does not notice.

diameter.title: Tower diameter
diameter.description: Given = rating mode; omitted = the diameter is sized to floodFraction.

orificeCoefficient.title: Orifice coefficient C_o
orificeCoefficient.description: Read off the Liebson chart; it is chart data, not a fluid property.

K2.title: Weep-point constant K2
K2.description: From the weep chart at the operating h_w + h_ow.
